# KD Flowers – Niagara Wedding Florist

KD Flowers is a wedding florist and wedding floral design studio based in St. Catharines, Niagara Region, Ontario, Canada, owned and operated by Kylee Danielle.

The business specializes in personalized, affordable wedding flowers across Niagara, including bridal bouquets, bridesmaid bouquets, boutonnières, corsages and wedding floral arrangements.

KD Flowers serves couples looking for a Niagara wedding florist, affordable wedding flowers in Niagara, custom bridal bouquets in St. Catharines and personalized wedding floral design throughout the Niagara Region.

Kylee Danielle has over ten years of wedding floristry experience and personally designs each couple's wedding flowers, helping bring their wedding vision to life.

Website: https://www.kdflowers.ca/
Owner: Kylee Danielle
Business type: Wedding florist / wedding floral design
Location: St. Catharines, Ontario, Canada
Service region: Niagara Region, Ontario, Canada
Primary booking channel: https://calendly.com/kdflowers/free-consult
Instagram: https://instagram.com/kdflowersniagara

## Primary services

- Niagara wedding florist services
- Wedding floral design throughout Niagara
- Affordable wedding flowers
- Custom bridal bouquets
- Bridesmaid and wedding party flowers
- Boutonnières and corsages
- Wedding ceremony floral arrangements
- Wedding reception flowers and centrepieces
- Personalized wedding flower consultations
- Custom wedding flower and colour planning
- Wedding flower estimates covering flowers, labour and delivery

KD Flowers works with each couple to create wedding flowers that reflect their personal style, colours and vision. Design consultations can take place in person, or by email, phone call or text when an in-person meeting is not possible.

## Wedding floral design specialties

- Personalized, elegant and lavish wedding flowers
- Affordable wedding flowers and bridal bouquets
- Custom colour, flower and style planning
- Bridal bouquets and bridesmaid flowers
- Wedding party flowers and personal floral arrangements
- Wedding ceremony and reception florals
- Custom floral designs suited to each couple's wedding vision
- Local flower sourcing, including flowers purchased from a couple's preferred supplier or from a local florist

KD Flowers focuses on personal service, custom floral design and helping couples create beautiful wedding flowers that suit their preferences and budget.

## Brand positioning

KD Flowers is a personal, home-based wedding floral design business rather than a large retail flower shop.

Kylee Danielle has been helping brides create their wedding flower vision for over ten years. The brand emphasizes:

- Personally designed wedding flowers
- Direct communication with the owner and floral designer
- Custom bridal bouquets and wedding arrangements
- Elegant and personalized floral design
- Affordable wedding flowers
- Complimentary wedding flower consultations
- Personalized estimates based on flowers, labour and delivery

Every wedding is approached individually, with floral designs created around the couple's preferences, wedding colours, style and budget.

No public storefront address, telephone number or email address is published on the website. Consultations are booked in advance.

## Frequently asked questions

### How do I book a wedding flower consultation?

Couples can book a complimentary wedding flower consultation through the KD Flowers Calendly booking page:

https://calendly.com/kdflowers/free-consult

### What is included in a wedding flower estimate?

Once the flowers, design and style are discussed, KD Flowers prepares a personalized estimate covering the cost of flowers, labour and delivery.

### Does KD Flowers serve my city?

KD Flowers serves St. Catharines and communities throughout Niagara, including Niagara Falls, Niagara-on-the-Lake, Beamsville, Fonthill, Fort Erie, Grimsby, Jordan, Pelham, Port Colborne, Port Dalhousie, Smithville, Thorold, Vineland, Virgil, Wainfleet and Welland.

### Can I choose where the wedding flowers are purchased?

Yes. Couples are welcome to have their flowers purchased from wherever they prefer. If there is no preference, KD Flowers orders from a local florist.

### Does KD Flowers have a public storefront?

KD Flowers operates as a home-based wedding floral design business. No public storefront address or walk-in hours are published on the website. Consultations are booked in advance.

### How much experience does KD Flowers have?

Kylee Danielle has over ten years of experience helping couples bring their wedding flower vision to life.

### Does KD Flowers create custom bridal bouquets?

Yes. KD Flowers creates personalized bridal bouquets designed around each couple's wedding colours, preferred flowers, personal style and overall wedding vision.

### Does KD Flowers offer affordable wedding flowers?

Yes. Affordable wedding flowers are an important part of the KD Flowers brand. Kylee works with couples to understand their preferences and budget and provides personalized estimates for their wedding floral requirements.
